detail.longDescription:
I am working on a website which has a CRT effect over the main page, however I would like to give the users the option to turn it off. I'm new to JS but I've managed to set up a checkbox toggle which works, but I'm having trouble getting it to save to local storage. When I load the page, it defaults to CRT on and the checkbox unchecked, and if I toggle it off and reload I need to click the checkbox twice to see any change again. This is the current code I'm using (with help from here and here ): :root { --crt: block; } /* crt fx */ #pagecontainer::before, #pagecontainer::after { display: var(--crt); pointer-events: none; content: ""; position: absolute; } #pagecontainer::before { width: 100%; height: 3px; z-index: 1000; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); opacity: 0.75; } #pagecontainer::after { top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; z-index: 1000; background: linear-gradient( to bottom, transparent 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 51% ); background-size: 100% 3px; }
const root = document.querySelector(":root"); const toggle = document.getElementById("data-crt"); const storedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme'); if (storedTheme) { document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-crt', storedTheme) } toggle.onclick = function() { const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-crt"); let targetTheme = "nocrt"; root.style.setProperty("--crt", 'none'); if (currentTheme === "nocrt") { targetTheme = "crt"; root.style.setProperty("--crt", 'block'); } document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-crt', targetTheme) localStorage.setItem('theme', targetTheme); };
